name: Blade Runner 2049
description: Slow, brooding and vast. A lonely, melancholic drift through a cold neon-lit future, full of rain, silence and quiet longing for something real.

name: Interstellar
description: Awestruck, solemn and aching. A slow-building, majestic swell of wonder and dread, where immense silence gives way to towering crescendos and a deep, tearful yearning for home.

name: Drive
description: Cool, hypnotic and dangerous. A sleek nocturnal glide under glowing streetlights, calm and dreamy on the surface, with pulsing synthetic warmth interrupted by sudden flashes of brutal violence.

name: Lost in Translation
description: Hushed, wistful and intimate. A hazy, jet-lagged late-night stillness, gently drifting through sleepless hours with soft detachment, dry humor and a fleeting, tender sense of connection.

name: Whiplash
description: Tense, relentless and obsessive. A fast, sweaty, nerve-wracking push toward perfection, driven by pounding rhythm, pressure and explosive bursts of intensity.

name: La La Land
description: Romantic, colorful and yearning. A bright, swinging burst of starry-eyed optimism that slowly fades into a soft, graceful ache for dreams chased and love left behind.

name: Pulp Fiction
description: Swaggering, cool and irreverent. A loose, talkative swagger with a retro, sun-bleached attitude, strutting between laid-back banter and jolts of dark, absurd, unpredictable danger.

name: Spirited Away
description: Enchanting, mysterious and tender. A wide-eyed wander through a strange, shimmering dreamworld, mixing childlike wonder, eerie unease and calm, flowing moments of quiet melancholy.

name: Parasite
description: Sly, uneasy and biting. A darkly comic, tightly wound slow burn that starts playful and elegant, then tightens into claustrophobic dread and a sudden, bitter eruption.

name: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: Furious, loud and relentless. A wild, high-speed rush of chaos, heat and aggression that barely pauses for breath, raw and exhilarating.

name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: Quirky, elegant and nostalgic. A brisk, precisely ticking caper with pastel charm and deadpan mischief, skipping along lightly while a faint sadness for a vanished world lingers.

name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
description: Fragile, dreamlike and heartbroken. A blurry, fragmented drift through fading memories, intimate and disorienting, shifting between wintry sadness, awkward tenderness and a stubborn flicker of hope.

name: Amélie
description: Whimsical, warm and playful. A light, tender daydream full of small joys, shy romance and nostalgic charm, moving at a gentle, bouncing pace.

name: The Great Beauty
description: Decadent, languid and contemplative. A lavish, unhurried stroll from wild all-night revelry into sacred dawn stillness, soaked in world-weary irony, faded glamour and aching awe at beauty.

name: Breaking Bad
description: Gritty, simmering and ominous. A patient, sun-scorched slow burn of mounting pride and moral decay, dry and desolate, where long quiet stretches snap into sharp, ruthless tension.

name: Chernobyl
description: Bleak, suffocating and grave. A cold, grey, slow-creeping dread filled with invisible menace, droning unease and heavy sorrow, relentless in its stillness and utterly without comfort.

name: Fleabag
description: Sharp, restless and bittersweet. Quick, witty energy on the surface with grief and loneliness underneath, swinging between chaotic humor and sudden raw vulnerability.

name: Arcane
description: Electric, turbulent and tragic. A vivid, hard-hitting clash of gleaming grandeur and grimy rebellion, charging between explosive adrenaline, bruised anger and deep wounded heartache.

name: Severance
description: Sterile, eerie and off-kilter. A slow, clinical, fluorescent-lit unease with deadpan absurdity and creeping paranoia, minimal and hollow, building gradually toward anxious, breathless suspense.

name: Succession
description: Acidic, opulent and anxious. A prowling, stately tension of power and insecurity, laced with vicious wit and cold luxury, constantly circling without ever finding warmth or rest.

name: Time
description: Slow, dark and solemn. A quiet instrumental that builds patiently from near silence into a vast, aching swell, heavy with melancholy and a sense of time slipping away.

name: Weightless
description: Calm, floating and soothing. A very slow, drifting ambient haze with no urgency at all, soft and dreamlike, like floating half-asleep in warm water as every tension dissolves.

name: On the Nature of Daylight
description: Mournful, grave and beautiful. A slow, swelling lament of strings that rises with unbearable tenderness, heavy with grief, loss and regret, yet reaching toward something like forgiveness.

name: An Ending (Ascent) - Remastered 2005
description: Serene, luminous and vast. A motionless, glowing drift that feels like watching the planet from orbit, peaceful and awestruck, with a gentle sense of farewell and quiet transcendence.

name: Nuvole Bianche
description: Wistful, tender and yearning. A gentle piano piece that starts as a hesitant sigh and gathers into a flowing, emotional rush, bittersweet and romantic, full of longing for something lost.

name: Avril 14th
description: Delicate, innocent and fleeting. A brief, simple melody played softly as if on an old music box, pure and slightly sad, like a faded memory of a sunlit afternoon at home.

name: Clair de Lune, L. 32
description: Graceful, moonlit and contemplative. A very slow, shimmering reverie that ripples like light on still water at night, tender and romantic, full of hushed wonder and deep calm.

name: Gymnopédie No. 1
description: Sparse, melancholic and detached. A slow, gently swaying stroll through an empty room on a grey afternoon, quietly sad and unhurried, with a cool, elegant sense of solitude.

name: Comptine d'un autre été, l'après-midi
description: Whimsical, bittersweet and restless. A light, circling piano melody that moves at a steady walking pace, playful yet wistful, like wandering old streets lost in daydreams and small private sorrows.

name: One Summer Day
description: Gentle, nostalgic and wide-eyed. A soft, slowly unfolding melody filled with quiet awe, warm yet tinged with homesickness, like a child stepping alone into an unknown, enchanted world as a long holiday ends.

name: Nightcall
description: Dark, cool and hypnotic. A slow, heavy electronic pulse with a nocturnal, neon-lit mood, detached and brooding, like driving alone through an empty city at night.

name: A Real Hero
description: Tender, glowing and hopeful. A mid-tempo, soft pastel electronic haze with a breathy, innocent warmth, nostalgic and romantic, like a quiet drive at dusk beside someone you want to protect.

name: Blinding Lights
description: Urgent, sleek and exhilarating. A fast, driving retro pulse racing through bright night streets, glamorous yet desperate, full of restless longing and reckless speed toward someone out of reach.

name: Midnight City
description: Euphoric, soaring and nocturnal. A big, shimmering mid-tempo anthem of youthful freedom, glittering skylines and wide-open possibility, thrilling and slightly wistful, like the best night out before dawn arrives.

name: Little Dark Age
description: Eerie, sardonic and gothic. A steady, danceable groove with a cold, spooky edge, theatrical and paranoid, mixing dark humour with dread, like a masked ball in a haunted mansion.

name: Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams & Nile Rodgers) - Radio Edit
description: Smooth, flirtatious and carefree. A sleek, mid-tempo dance groove glowing with summer warmth, playful seduction and easy confidence, like a stylish party that lasts until sunrise.

name: Firestarter
description: Menacing, frantic and anarchic. A fast, pounding electronic assault full of snarling provocation and chaotic energy, abrasive and dangerous, like a riot breaking out in a strobe-lit basement.

name: Teardrop
description: Haunting, hushed and hypnotic. A slow, steady heartbeat pulse beneath a fragile, ethereal voice, dark and intimate, suspended between sorrow and tenderness like a slow-motion fall through deep water.

name: Glory Box
description: Sultry, smoky and aching. A slow, heavy, noir-tinged sway dripping with weary desire and wounded longing, sensual and dramatic, like a torch song in a dim, half-empty bar.

name: Playground Love
description: Hazy, sensual and sorrowful. A slow, velvety drift soaked in teenage longing and suburban boredom, soft and sleepy, like a faded photograph of a first love doomed to end.

name: Space Song
description: Dreamy, starry and heartbroken. A slow, swaying float through shimmering haze, sweet and lovesick, like drifting untethered through a night sky while quietly letting go of someone.

name: Apocalypse
description: Languorous, intimate and nocturnal. A slow, reverb-soaked whisper of devotion, tender and melancholy, like two lovers holding each other in a dark bedroom while the world outside quietly falls apart.

name: Fade Into You
description: Woozy, lovelorn and resigned. A slow, swaying acoustic waltz drenched in sleepy yearning, soft and dusty, like loving someone who never quite looks back at you across a late-summer haze.

name: Intro
description: Minimal, tense and anticipatory. A steady, mid-tempo instrumental build with a cool, shadowy pulse, restrained yet urgent, like the opening moments before something important begins in the dark.

name: Nights
description: Restless, introspective and bittersweet. A shifting, sleepless late-night confession that moves from jittery hustle to a slow, hazy comedown, weary and nostalgic, full of memories of harder days.

name: Between The Bars
description: Hushed, intimate and fragile. A soft, bare acoustic whisper, sad and tender, like a late-night confession full of loneliness and quiet resignation.

name: Hallelujah
description: Reverent, sorrowful and yearning. A slow, sparse and intimate lament that rises from a trembling hush into aching, almost sacred longing, full of heartbreak, devotion and fragile beauty.

name: Skinny Love
description: Raw, wounded and wintry. A slow, bare acoustic plea that cracks with desperation and regret, like the bitter last days of a love falling apart in a cold, isolated cabin.

name: Pink Moon
description: Gentle, wistful and mysterious. A brief, softly flowing acoustic reverie, calm and pastoral on the surface yet shadowed by a quiet, lonely sense of foreboding under a night sky.

name: Karma Police
description: Weary, uneasy and haunting. A slow, deliberate piano-led march of cold irony and creeping paranoia that gradually dissolves into a dazed, disoriented collapse, like a mind quietly coming apart.

name: Take Five
description: Cool, suave and playful. A breezy, lightly swinging instrumental with an off-kilter stride, relaxed and sophisticated, like a smoky late-night lounge full of wit and easy confidence.

name: So What (feat. John Coltrane, Cannonball Adderley & Bill Evans)
description: Laid-back, spacious and contemplative. A mellow, unhurried instrumental that strolls with understated cool, hazy and nocturnal, like wandering lost in thought through quiet streets after midnight.

name: Feeling Good
description: Triumphant, soulful and bold. A slow, smouldering rise from a lone bare voice into a brassy, powerful declaration of freedom, rebirth and hard-won self-assurance at the dawn of a new day.

name: My Funny Valentine
description: Tender, melancholy and dreamy. A very slow, soft and delicate murmur of bittersweet affection, drifting through a dim, empty room in the small hours with fragile, wistful romance.

name: Son Of A Preacher Man
description: Sultry, warm and nostalgic. A relaxed, mid-paced soulful sway full of sly sweetness and fond remembrance, like recalling a secret first romance on a humid summer evening.

name: Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)
description: Haunting, sparse and mournful. A slow, eerie tale carried by a lone trembling echo, heavy with betrayal, lost innocence and a cold, fatal sense of doomed love and revenge.

name: September
description: Joyful, bright and irresistible. An upbeat, danceable groove bursting with warmth, celebration and carefree happiness.

name: Uptown Funk (feat. Bruno Mars)
description: Swaggering, flashy and playful. A tight, strutting groove packed with cocky charm and showy confidence, like a slick crew taking over the street on a hot Saturday night.

name: Dancing Queen
description: Euphoric, glittering and bittersweet. A sweeping, mid-tempo swirl of youthful abandon under shimmering lights, radiant and romantic, tinged with nostalgia for a perfect night that cannot last.

name: Don't Stop Me Now - Remastered 2011
description: Exhilarated, theatrical and unstoppable. A fast, jubilant rush of reckless delight that accelerates like a rocket through the night sky, flamboyant and giddy with invincible, breathless freedom.

name: Here Comes The Sun - Remastered 2009
description: Hopeful, gentle and sunny. A light, easy-flowing melody full of relief and quiet optimism, like the first warm morning after a long, cold winter finally thaws.

name: Alors on danse - Radio Edit
description: Jaded, weary and compulsive. A steady, pulsing club beat with a deadpan mood, moving mechanically to forget everyday fatigue and disappointment, numb and restless beneath the flashing lights.

name: Killing In The Name
description: Angry, loud and explosive. A heavy, aggressive groove that builds into a furious, defiant outburst of raw rebellion and adrenaline.

name: Smells Like Teen Spirit
description: Restless, sardonic and cathartic. A lurching swing between murky, sullen quiet and a roaring, distorted release of youthful frustration and apathy, like a bored crowd finally erupting.

name: Master Of Puppets
description: Menacing, relentless and intense. A fast, pummelling onslaught of dark, mechanical fury, epic and claustrophobic, like being dragged helplessly toward ruin by a force too strong to resist.

name: HUMBLE.
description: Confrontational, cocky and stark. A hard, stripped-down, pounding beat with a commanding, taunting bite, cold and minimal, radiating dominance and bravado, like a warning delivered face to face.

name: Beggin'
description: Gritty, desperate and seductive. A driving, stomping plea with raspy urgency and rough glamour, feverish and pleading, like a reckless gambler chasing one last chance at love.

name: Comfortably Numb
description: Detached, dreamlike and majestic. A slow, floating haze of sedated emptiness and distant childhood memory that swells into a soaring, anguished cry of isolation and loss.

name: La vie en rose
description: Romantic, lush and old-fashioned. A slow, swooning serenade glowing with devotion and rosy wonder, like a couple waltzing by lamplight on a quiet street, sentimental and blissfully in love.

name: Sweet Dreams (Are Made of This) - Remastered
description: Cold, sleek and ominous. A steady, mechanical electronic pulse with a cynical, seductive edge, mysterious and trance-like, like a restless search for desire and power in a dark dream.
